title: A clear brief. A useful handover.
intro: A small, defined first step keeps the scope, files and decisions visible.

steps.title: 01 · Send the brief
steps.text: Include the product list, CAD or photos, reference links, finish options, target platforms and deadline.

steps.title: 02 · Confirm scope
steps.text: A written quote defines deliverables, revision rounds, file formats, milestones and what counts as new scope.

steps.title: 03 · Review checkpoints
steps.text: Review the model, materials and data before the final exports are prepared.

steps.title: 04 · Handover
steps.text: Receive named, organized files and a concise note on how to use them.

terms: Turnaround counts working days from deposit and a complete brief.
Every enquiry is acknowledged within 24 hours.
Written quotes are sent within 24 hours for standard work and within 48 hours for configurators.
Two revision rounds are included; extra rounds are billed hourly.
Packages under $500 are paid 100% upfront or through platform escrow. Larger projects use 50/50 payments; Configurator Pro uses 40/30/30 by milestone.
